headlines.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO. Stock skyrockets 31%
headlines.summary: This is the tape-moving story of the year — Nvidia posting its biggest single-day gain in stock-market history, dragging the entire AI ecosystem with it. The ripple hit semiconductors, cloud names, credit markets, and Asian bourses overnight, making this a global event, not just a single-name pop. When the White House is brokering CEO reinstatements and short sellers are getting carried out on stretchers, you know the bid under this market just got a whole lot firmer.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44 billion deal as AI supercharges cyberattacks
headlines.summary: A $44 billion cybersecurity mega-merger is no small thing — this reshapes the entire sector's competitive landscape and will force every player from Palo Alto to SentinelOne to reprice their strategic value. Zscaler shareholders are sitting on a deal premium, while CrowdStrike holders are digesting whether this is a bold power move or an expensive stretch. M&A of this size in a high-multiple sector always rattles the whole neighborhood.

headlines.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
headlines.summary: Williams isn't a backbencher — he runs the New York Fed and his words move the long bond. Signaling rates stay higher for longer is a direct headwind for rate-sensitive sectors like real estate and utilities, and it puts a ceiling on how far this equity bounce can run. On a day when the market is already celebrating, this is the cold water nobody wants to hear about.
